scope: Official native Q8 eight-channel activity; one continuous cached stream, uniform0.5 frame threshold. Anonymous IDs only, not separated words or real names/roles. No reference input.

identityReviewPolicy.groups: Number of distinct anonymous IDs already predicted by the frozen full native journal, not reference people
identityReviewPolicy.features: All exact previously saved clean>=2s ERes2Net vectors; no new embeddings or selected first profiles
identityReviewPolicy.clustering: Cosine dissimilarity, average-link hierarchical clustering, maxclust at predicted group count; one fixed method, no cutoff or group-count scan
identityReviewPolicy.displayIdMapping: Global maximum duration agreement between vector clusters and original anonymous IDs; predicted data only
identityReviewPolicy.shortIntervals: For a shorter clean run, revise only when preceding and following eligible runs for that original ID have the same reconciled label; otherwise retain original
identityReviewPolicy.overlapAndActivity: Preserve all original multivoice intervals, every activity boundary and activity multiplicity; no missing speech is invented
identityReviewPolicy.acceptance: Both complete ordinary cases must meet original DER<=10% and old per-person regressions remain explicit; raw/per-person text gates unchanged
identityReviewPolicy.stop: One fixed cached-data reconciliation; no parameter variants after full scores
